systems.owner: Ministry of Education; funded in 2018 through Global Partnership for Education programme implementation grants
systems.tiers: the review's 2022-2032 blueprint sets, as a target for its first one to two years, tracking of school attendance and teacher-learner ratio in NEMIS by 100 per cent of primary schools, then pre-primary and secondary in years three to five

systems.platform: digital devices for schools, some assembled locally at Moi University and JKUAT
systems.owner: Government of Kenya (MoE, MoICT, ICT Authority)
systems.tiers: primary schools; local assembly serving over 23,000 primary schools

note: Passages of a 2022 review of the Digital Literacy Programme: NEMIS is named as an online data platform and as where attendance tracking is to be ensured, a recommendation and not a statement that schools enter attendance, so it is left unclassified and no fact is taken.
